newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH POWER UTILITY CEZ 1996 NET PROFIT FLAT.
newsitem.headline: CZECH POWER UTILITY CEZ 1996 NET PROFIT FLAT.

text.p: The main Czech power producer, CEZ a.s., posted after-tax 1996 profit of 8.11 billion crowns, compared with 8.06 billion crowns in 1995, according to filings with the Prague Stock Exchange, obtained on Tuesday.

It said that pre-tax profit fell to 13.41 billion crowns from 14.78 billion crowns, according to figures calculated according to Czech accounting standards which are still subject to an external audit.
Note. Full company name is CEZ a.s., the primary generator
and distrubtor of electrical power in the Czech Republic. These
results are unaudited and were prepared according to Czech
